heading: REGIONAL REGULATION OF PARIGI MOUTONG REGENCY
translated_text:
REGIONAL REGULATION OF PARIGI MOUTONG REGENCY

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

BY THE GRACE OF GOD ALMIGHTY

REGENT OF PARIGI MOUTONG

Considering

heading: !'I J
BUPAT] PARIO!MOUTONO
translated_text:
BUPAT] PARIO!MOUTONO

HAS DECIDED:

To Establish A REGIONAL REGULATION CONCERNING THE PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE.

heading: CHAPTER I
translated_text:
CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1 In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by: ;
1. Region is the Regency Region of Parigi Moutong.

2. Regional Government is the Regent as an element of the Regional Government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.
3. Regent is the Regent of Parigi Moutong.
4. Regional Apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Regent and the Regional House of Representatives in the administration of government affairs that are the authority of the Region.
5. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child still in the womb.
6. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and organizations and/or community organizations.
7. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife, or husband and wife and their children, or father and his children, or mother and her children, or blood relatives in direct lineage upward or downward up to the third degree.
8. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually, and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of liberty;
9. Violence against Women is any action that results in or may result in misery or suffering of Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life.
10. Violence against Children is any act against a Child that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the Child
11. Victim is a Woman and Child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of Violence.
12. Protection of Women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecutor's office, courts, social institutions, or other parties who know or hear that Violence against Women will or has occurred ;
13. Protection of Children is all activities to guarantee and protect Children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop, and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and dignity, and receive protection from Violence and discrimination.
14. Special Protection is a form of protection received by Children in certain situations and conditions to obtain a guarantee of security against threats that endanger themselves and their lives in their growth and development.
15. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to the Victim when seeing, hearing and knowing that Violence against the Victim will, is or has occurred.
16. Companion is a person or representative from an institution who has the expertise to accompany Victims to conduct counseling, therapy and advocacy for strengthening and recovery of Violence Victims.
17. Assistance is all actions in the form of counseling, psychological therapy, advocacy, and spiritual guidance, for strengthening Violence Victims to resolve the problems they face.
18. Repatriation is an effort to return Women and Child Victims of Violence to the family, or community that can provide protection and fulfill their needs.
19. Counseling is a process of providing objective and complete information, carried out systematically with interpersonal communication guidance, counseling techniques and mastery of clinical knowledge aimed at helping a person recognize their current condition, the problems being faced, and determine solutions or efforts to overcome these problems. . .
20. Rehabilitation is the recovery of Victims from psychosocial disorders and the restoration of normal social functioning, both in the family and in society.

::

21. Social Reintegration is an effort to reunite Victims with family, community, institutions, or other social environments that can provide protection.
22. Restitution is payment of compensation charged to the perpetrator based on a court decision that has permanent legal force for material and/or immaterial losses suffered by the victim or their heirs.
23. Technical Implementation Unit of the Women and Child Protection Service, hereinafter abbreviated as UPTD PPA is the Technical Implementation Unit of the Women and Child Protection Service of Parigi Moutong Regency.
24. Integrated Service Center for Women and Child Empowerment, hereinafter referred to as P2TP2A is an integrated service provider institution for Victims established by the Regional Government.
25. Minimum Service Standards hereinafter abbreviated as SPM is a performance benchmark for integrated service units in providing complaint handling services, health services, social rehabilitation, law enforcement and legal assistance as well as repatriation and social reintegration for Women and Child Victims of Violence.
26. Social Welfare Organizing Institution hereinafter referred to as LPKS is an institution or social service place that carries out the implementation of social welfare for Children in conflict with the law, established by the ministry of social affairs.
27. Safe House is a temporary residence, provided to provide protection to Victims in accordance with predetermined standards.

PROTECTION OF WOMEN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE
Part Two
translated_text:
Part Two

Prevention of Acts of Violence

heading: Article 16
Article 7
translated_text:
Article 7

(1) The Regional Government is obliged to prepare prevention programs or activities as referred to in Article 6 in the Regional Work Plan and Regional Strategic Plan.
(2) Programs or activities as referred to in paragraph (1) are to support the realization of the Regional Long-Term Development Plan and Regional Medium-Term Development Plan.

heading: Part Three
translated_text:
Part Three

Integrated Services for Victims of Acts of Violence

heading: Article 8
Article 9
translated_text:
Article 9

(1) Complaint services as referred to in Article 8 paragraph (1) letter a shall be implemented to receive reports of acts of violence.

(2) Reports as referred to in paragraph (1) may come from:
a. victims;
b. referrals; or
c. outreach.

heading: Article 10
Article 11
Article 12
translated_text:
Article 12

(1) Repatriation and social reintegration as referred to in Article 8 paragraph (1) letter g shall be implemented with the following principles:
a. voluntary;
b. safe and dignified; and
c. respect for rights.

(2) In the event that the Regional Government is not yet able to implement repatriation and social reintegration as referred to in paragraph (1), it may request assistance from relevant parties.
(3) Social services to provide social welfare for children in conflict with the law shall be carried out by the Regional Government together with LPKS and other social institutions.
(4) LPKS and other social institutions as referred to in paragraph (3) are rehabilitation and temporary shelter facilities for children in conflict with the law before repatriation and social reintegration are implemented.

heading: Part Four
translated_text:
Part Four

Empowerment of Victims of Acts of Violence

heading: Article 13
translated_text:
Article 13

(1) The Regional Government shall empower victims of acts of violence in the form of:
a. job training;
b. productive economic enterprises and joint business groups; and
c. capital assistance.
(2) Empowerment as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be implemented by Regional Apparatus in accordance with their duties and functions.

Pasa128 (1) The Regional Government conducts guidance and supervision of P2TP2A. (2) Guidance and supervision shall be carried out by the Regional Apparatus tasked with and responsible for the field of women's empowerment and child protection. (3) The results of the implementation of guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (2) must be reported to the Regent.

heading: BABX
translated_text:
BABX

PEMBIAYAAN

Pasal29 Financing for the protection of women and children from acts of violence may be sourced from: ,a. Regional Revenue and Expenditure Budget; and/or
b. other lawful sources that are non-binding in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

Pasal30 (1) The Regional Government may provide financial assistance to community organizations, social organizations, or non-governmental organizations that carry out protection of women and children from acts of violence.

2. Financial assistance as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be in accordance with the Regional financial capacity and implemented in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

heading: BABXI
translated_text:
BABXI

KETENTUAN PERALIHAN

Pasal31 Activities for the Protection of Women and Children Victims of Acts of Violence organized by P2TP2A before this Regional Regulation is promulgated, are declared to remain valid until the establishment of the Technical Implementation Unit of the Women's and Children's Protection Service by the Regional Government.

heading: BABX
translated_text:
BABX

KETENTUAN PENUTUP

Pasal32 This Regional Regulation shall come into force on the date of promulgation.

In order that everyone may know of it, the promulgation of this Regional Regulation is ordered by its placement in the Regional Gazette of Parigi Moutong Regency.

heading: PENJELASAN
translated_text:
PENJELASAN

ATAS

PERATURAN DAERAH KABUPATEN PARIGI MOUTONG

NOMOR TAHUN 2018

TENTANG

PERLINDUNGAN PEREMPUAN DAN ANAK KORBAN KEKERASAN I. UMUM

Acts of Violence against Women and Children constitute violations of human rights so that their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination. In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in Parigi Moutong Regency so that they are protected from Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades their degree and human dignity, it is necessary to provide protection to Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of regional regulations. Thus far, laws and regulations governing the protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence have not regulated protection efforts in the Region, so institutional support and regulations are needed that can guarantee its implementation. This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of prevention, services and empowerment of Women and Children Victims of Violence in Parigi Moutong Regency.
